note: Summaries are written for this app. The verse text stays in bphs_ch24.json.

variants.summary: Good physical comfort and strong personal drive. The native is capable and quick-minded, with a restless streak. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.

Earns well, gains learning, and is content. Courteous, principled and respected, with many good qualities. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
Bold and courageous, with the drive to build wealth of every kind. Respected, clever and content. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
Happiness from both parents and a comfortable home life. Has many siblings, enjoys life's pleasures, and is attractive and well-mannered.

Happiness from children is moderate, and the text warns of difficulty around the first child; read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising it. The native is proud and quick to anger, and finds favour with people in authority.
Physical comfort is reduced and health needs care. Malefics join the lord and no benefic aspects it, so the text also warns of trouble from opponents.
Physical comfort is reduced and health needs care. The text's warning about opponents needs malefics joining the lord with no benefic aspect, which this chart does not have.

With a malefic lagna lord here, the text warns of serious strain on the spouse's health and wellbeing. Weigh the 7th lord, Venus, and any benefic aspect on the 7th before drawing a conclusion, and keep this as background for your own judgment.

With a benefic lagna lord here, life takes one of several turns: much travel, lean periods, a detached outlook, or at the other end, high status and authority. The lord's strength shows which way it leans.

Gifted in occult and hidden subjects. The text also warns of poor health, a fierce temper, and a pull toward risky or dishonest ways such as gambling and secret affairs. Health and conduct are the areas to watch.
Fortunate and well liked. Devotional by nature (the text names devotion to Vishnu), capable and a good speaker, and blessed with spouse, children and wealth.
Happiness from the father, honour from people in authority, and a good name in public. Wealth comes through the native's own effort, which the text states without doubt.
Steady gains throughout life, good character, and a wide reputation. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
Physical comfort is reduced, money goes on fruitless spending, and the native is short-tempered.
The text gives reduced comfort, fruitless spending and a short temper here only when no benefic joins or aspects the lord. A benefic does in this chart, so the verse's warning is held back.
Has children and wealth, but is harsh, a source of friction in the family, and busy with other people's affairs. Strong appetites run through the nature.
Wealthy and proud. The text also mentions more than one partner, or else difficulty with children; check the 7th and 5th houses before reading this to a client.
Brave, intelligent and well-meaning, though also driven by desire and greed. Benefics join the lord, so the good qualities come forward.
Brave, intelligent and well-meaning, though also driven by desire and greed. Malefics join the lord, so the text warns of irreverence toward the sacred.
Brave, intelligent and well-meaning, though also driven by desire and greed.
Prosperity of every kind. Jupiter joins the lord and the lord stands in its own or exaltation sign, so the text raises this to near-royal standing.
Prosperity of every kind.
Wealthy, and the children too are inclined to build and keep wealth.
Benefics join the lord, so the native gains wealth through rivals or competition.
Malefics join the lord, so the text warns of losses through rivals and trouble in the legs or limbs.
Money comes and goes through rivals and disputes. The text turns this on whether benefics or malefics join the lord; here neither side does on its own, so the outcome stays open.

Skill in healing or medicine. The text also warns about faithfulness in relationships. With malefics joining or aspecting the lord, the text extends the warning to the spouse; read the 7th house carefully before saying anything.
Skill in healing or medicine. The text also warns about faithfulness in relationships.
Plenty of land and money, but little happiness in marriage and none from elder siblings.
Wealthy, hardworking and skilled. Health is delicate in childhood and improves later in life. Drawn to pilgrimage, vows and religious practice.

Passionate, respected, learned and very wealthy, though happiness from children is lacking; read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising it. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
Gains of every kind. Hardworking, honoured and well known.
Courageous yet short of money, leaning on the fortunes of others. Happiness from the eldest child is lacking; read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising it.
Earns wealth through own effort. Brave and intelligent, able in service, and capable even without formal education.
Heavy-bodied and lacking courage, takes on small ventures, and is not content. The text also warns of coveting other people's wealth and partners.
Happiness from siblings, wealth and children, and a joyful, contented life.
Happy, wealthy and intelligent, though the text warns of a difficult spouse.
Has children and good qualities. Malefics join or aspect the lord, so the text warns of a harsh-tempered spouse.
Has children and good qualities.
Very wealthy, but at odds with siblings and with maternal uncles, while close to maternal aunts.
Works in government or public service. Childhood is unhappy, and life improves steadily toward the end.
Earns through service to others, with a pull toward dishonest ways. The text also warns of serious trouble with the authorities.
Little happiness from the father, but fortune rises through women, and there is happiness from children and family.
Every comfort and self-earned wealth. The text also warns about faithfulness in relationships.
Always profitable in business. Intelligent and brave even without formal education, and works in service of others.
Spends on the wrong things, and the father is harsh. Fortune rises through women.
Learned and virtuous, owns land and vehicles, and enjoys the mother's happiness.
Enjoys life and has wealth of every kind. Close to family, respected, bold and shrewd.
Brave, healthy, generous and charitable, with people to help and wealth earned through own effort.
Becomes a minister or counsellor, with wealth of every kind. Skilled, principled, respected, learned, well liked and happy.
Happy, liked by all, devotional (the text names devotion to Vishnu), virtuous and respected, with self-earned wealth.
Little happiness or comfort from the mother. The text also warns of a hot temper, dishonest ways, a pull toward indulgence, and an ill-intentioned mind.
Very learned, yet lets go of the father's wealth and falls silent in public gatherings.
Deprived of comforts such as a home, little happiness for the parents, and a lack of vigour.
Liked by all, devout, virtuous and respected, with happiness of every kind.
Honoured by the government, skilled in chemistry or medicine (the text says rasayana), joyful, comfortable and self-controlled.
Generous, virtuous, charitable and devoted to helping others. The text warns of hidden illnesses.
Deprived of comforts such as a home, given to bad habits and poor judgment, and held back by laziness.
Learned, with happiness from children, but miserly, scheming, and tempted by others' wealth.
Many children and wealth. Supports the family, is respected and well known, and is fond of company.
Fond of siblings and devoted to own work, but miserly and spiteful.
Happy, prosperous and intelligent, with the mother's happiness. Becomes an adviser to those in power, or a teacher.
Virtuous and fond of friends. Benefics aspect the lord, so the text promises children.
Virtuous and fond of friends. Malefics aspect the lord, so the text warns of difficulty having children; read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising it.
Virtuous and fond of friends. Whether children come depends on which planets aspect the lord, and this chart gives a mixed or neutral picture.
Strained relations with a child, or the text's harder outcomes: loss of children, or a child by adoption; read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising it.
Respected and righteous, with happiness from children and others, and devoted to helping people.
Little happiness from children, chest and breathing trouble, irritability, and a general lack of contentment.
A child rises to high standing, or the native becomes a well-known author and the pride of the family.
Forms a Raja Yoga: many comforts and wide fame.
Learned, well liked, an author, very skilled, with many children and wealth.
Little happiness from children, or a child by adoption; read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising it.
Prone to illness yet famous. Wealthy, proud, brave and capable, though often the native's own worst enemy.
Brave, well known in the family, an able speaker, devoted to own work, and happy living abroad.
Short-tempered and lacking courage. A sibling acts like a rival, and employees are defiant.
Very wealthy and ambitious, but little happiness from the mother, with an envious, changeable and spiteful streak.
Wealth and possessions are unsteady, and there is friction with children and friends. Happy and compassionate, though self-centred.
Enmity within the family and community, friendships outside it, and moderate happiness and wealth.
Little happiness in marriage, but famous, virtuous, proud, brave and wealthy.
Prone to illness and at odds with learned people. The text also warns of coveting others' property, and about faithfulness in relationships.
Trades in wood, stone or similar goods, with gains and losses by turns.
Well known in the family line and happy abroad, but critical of and disrespectful toward the father.
Gains wealth from opponents. Virtuous, brave and respected, though happiness from children is lacking.
Spends constantly on vices, is hostile toward learned people, and has a streak of cruelty.
Clever yet impatient and ill-behaved, and prone to wind (vata) disorders. The text also warns about faithfulness in relationships.
Gains wealth through the spouse, but puts things off. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
The text warns of loss of children; a daughter may come, and a son only with effort. Read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising it.
Truthful, intelligent and principled, though the spouse is independent-minded and dental trouble is likely.
Proud, gifted, always cheerful, and master of much wealth.
The spouse's health suffers, or there is friction with women. Short-tempered and not content.
Happiness from the spouse. Brave, discerning and intelligent, with only wind (vata) disorders to watch.
Little happiness in marriage; the spouse may be unwell, difficult and unaccommodating.
Absorbed in the spouse and takes on many ventures. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
Principled, with wealth and children, though the spouse is independent-minded.
Gains wealth through marriage. Happiness from children is limited, with mainly daughters.
Short of money or tight-fisted, with an extravagant spouse. May earn through clothing or textiles.
Little bodily comfort, prone to wounds or ulcers, and irreverent toward religion and learned people.
Lacks physical strength, has little money, and lost wealth is hard to recover.
Little happiness from siblings. Lacks energy, help and stamina.
The text warns about the mother's wellbeing. Little happiness from home and land, and a risk of betraying friends.
Slow to learn, with little wisdom, but long-lived and wealthy.
Overcomes enemies, but health is troubled, with fears around snakes and water in childhood.

Marriage needs a close look here. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client. A malefic joins the lord, so the text also warns of losses in business.
Marriage needs a close look here. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
Long life.
The lord is weak, so the text gives an average lifespan and warns of dishonest and spiteful ways.
Long life when the lord is strong; when it is weak, the text gives an average lifespan and warns of dishonest ways.
At odds with religion and tradition, with a difficult spouse. The text also warns of coveting others' property.
Little happiness from the father, a habit of speaking ill of others, and a lack of steady work. No benefic aspects the lord, so the text stresses these results.
Little happiness from the father, a habit of speaking ill of others, and a lack of steady work. A benefic aspects the lord, which the text says softens these results.
Childhood is unhappy and life improves later. Malefics join the lord, so the text warns of a lack of wealth.
Childhood is unhappy and life improves later. Benefics join the lord, so the text promises a long life.
Childhood is unhappy and life improves later.
Spends constantly on ignoble things. Malefics join the lord, so the text stresses a concern about longevity; leave this out of a client reading.
Spends constantly on ignoble things. The text raises a concern about longevity mainly when malefics join the lord, which is not the case here.
Very fortunate and honoured by those in power. Good character, good looks, learning and public respect.
Learned, well liked and wealthy, with strong desires and happiness from spouse and children.
Happiness from siblings. Wealthy, virtuous, good-looking and of good character.
Happiness from home and vehicles, wealth of every kind, and devotion to the mother.
Fortunate through children. Devoted to teachers, steady, righteous and learned.
Little fortune, little happiness from maternal relatives, and constant trouble from opponents.
Happiness through marriage. Virtuous and famous, with the learning and devotion of a true scholar.
Short of good fortune, with no happiness from elder siblings.
Abundant fortune, virtue and good looks, and much happiness from siblings.
Rises to high office as a leader, minister or commander. Virtuous and respected by the public.
Wealth grows day by day. Devoted to elders, virtuous and meritorious.
Fortune shrinks. Spends constantly on good causes and loses money through hospitality.
Learned, famous, wealthy and poetic. Health is delicate in childhood, then life improves and wealth grows day by day.
Wealthy and gifted, honoured by the government, generous, with happiness from the father.
Happiness from siblings and helpers. Brave, virtuous, eloquent and truthful.
Happy and devoted to the mother's welfare. Owns vehicles, land and houses, and is virtuous and wealthy.
Learned in every subject, always cheerful, wealthy, and blessed with children.
Little happiness from the father. Clever, yet short of money and troubled by opponents.
Happiness in marriage. High-minded, virtuous, eloquent, and devoted to truth and dharma.
Short of meaningful work. Long-lived, but given to criticising others.
Rises to royal standing, by birth or by merit, with wealth and children.
Skilled in every task and happy. Brave, truthful, and devoted to the guru.
Wealth and children, cheerful, virtuous and truthful, and always happy.
Spends on government or official matters and lives with fear of opponents. Clever, but anxious.
Pure-minded, wealthy and happy. Fair in outlook, poetic and eloquent, with steady gains.
Wealth of every kind and every accomplishment. Generous, righteous and happy.
Skilled in every undertaking and wealthy, with happiness from siblings. Occasional colic or abdominal pain.
Gains through the mother's family, pilgrimages, and happiness from home and land.
The children are happy, learned and of good conduct. The native is righteous and happy.
Prone to illness, harsh in thinking, restless in movement, and troubled by opponents.
Steady gains through the spouse's family. Generous, virtuous, passionate and devoted to the spouse.
Losses in undertakings. Long-lived, though the text raises a concern about the spouse's longevity; leave this out of a client reading.
Born fortunate. Clever, truthful, honoured by those in power, and wealthy.
Honoured by those in power, gifted, true to own nature, intelligent, truthful and self-controlled.
Profit in every undertaking, with wisdom and happiness growing day by day.
Spends steadily on good causes and mixes with people from outside one's own culture. The text also mentions more than one partner; check the 7th house before reading this to a client.
Spends freely, lacks physical strength, is prone to phlegm or cold disorders, and is short of wealth and learning.
Spends steadily on good causes. Righteous, pleasant-spoken, gifted and happy.
Little happiness from siblings, at odds with others, and focused on own body and comfort.
Little happiness from the mother, and steady losses through land, vehicles and houses.
Short of children and education, spends on a child's behalf, and is drawn to pilgrimage. Read the 5th house and Jupiter before raising the matter of children.
Creates friction with own people. Angry and unhappy. The text also warns about faithfulness in relationships.
Constant spending caused by the spouse, little happiness in marriage, and a lack of strength and learning.
Steady gains, sweet speech, a medium lifespan, and many virtues.
At odds with teachers, friction even with friends, and intent on own interests.
Expenses through the government or authorities, and little happiness from the father.
Gains slip away, though money held or kept by others sometimes comes to the native.
Heavy spending, little physical comfort, anger, and hostility toward others.
